title: Rename the projects:recent IPC channel to <noun>:<verb>
notes: projects:recent (src/main/main.ts:497, src/preload/preload.ts:6) breaks app-rule-1: recent is an adjective, so the channel names a thing and no action, and docs/app/hard-rules.md's claim that every preload channel follows the rule stays untrue. Cost: the next list channel on projects copies the shape. Fix: rename to recent-projects:read in both files and name it in the app-rule-1 entry. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/145 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/141#discussion_r4435507014

comments.body: Shipped in #151: projects:recent renamed to recent-projects:read in main and preload, app-rule-1 entry updated, version 2.32.12.
Shipped in #151: projects:recent IPC channel renamed to recent-projects:read; app-rule-1 docs name the pushed event channels it does not cover yet.
